description: Returns the current scheduled Hodge and lag-relation snapshots, coverage, observation times, invariants and timestamped history for configured market, DePIN and world cohorts. Requires an API key on a paid tier that includes the engines capability (https://kairossignal.com/pricing), sent in the X-API-Key header of the MCP connection; the free starter key from register_agent does not include it, and a call without a qualifying key is refused with isError. Descriptive relationships only: no fitted memory kernel, causal attribution, calibrated anomaly probability or trading-performance claim. Missing or stale inputs remain explicitly unavailable.
